Usage

Iteratively extracts up to max_planes planes via repeated RANSAC (remaining residual points are -1).

ransac_fit.ransac_plane is applied to the remaining point set; if the inlier count of its largest-consensus plane is at least min_inliers, a new label is assigned and those points are removed → detection is repeated on the rest. Separates several floors / walls / stair-like surfaces at once (the difference from pcseg, which fits a single plane). It stops as soon as the inliers fall short of min_inliers, and the remaining points are residual -1 (spheres and complex objects stay here).

Args:

points: (N,3) point cloud.

thresh: inlier threshold on point-plane distance (a distance, must be > 0).

min_inliers: minimum inlier count to accept a plane (must be >= 3).

max_planes: maximum number of planes to extract (must be >= 1).

iters: number of iterations of each RANSAC.

seed: random seed (deterministic; each plane uses seed + plane index).

Returns:

labels: (N,) int. 0,1,2,... assigned to planes in order of detection (≈ descending consensus);

residual points belonging to no plane are -1. Empty input gives shape (0,).

The 3d op plane_segmentation bridged into the 2-D evolution registry. The implementation is the same; only the calling convention is adapted to op(v, a, b). a sweeps max_planes (default 5) and b sweeps iters (default 300).
